title: Humanity’s Last Code Exam: Can Advanced LLMs Conquer Human’s Hardest Code Competition?

live_model.evidence: "even state-of-the-art models o4-mini(high) and Gemini-2.5 Pro achieve only 15.1% and 11.4% pass@1 rates"; Table 2 row "o4-mini (High) 25.21 43.84 6.48 14.77 15.85 29.31".

prompt.location: Sec. 3 (benchmark construction); problem statements extracted from IOI/ICPC sources
prompt.note: Models are given the official competition problem statement and asked to produce a solution; no separate custom instruction template is quoted.

claim.metric: average pass@1 across HLCE competitive-programming problems
claim.location: Table 2 (HLCE code generation task), row 'o4-mini (High)', Avg. column

data.source: 235 curated problems from IOI and ICPC World Finals (2010-2024); problem statements are from public competition archives, but official grading test cases are not confirmed redistributable

notes: "o3-mini" and "o4-mini" appear undated in the body text; resolved via the still-callable list since each name maps to exactly one released API snapshot (o3-mini-2025-01-31, o4-mini-2025-04-16). "High" denotes maximum reasoning effort, which raises real per-call cost above typical o4-mini usage.
